method: Dataset cards, Zenodo/GitHub/Hugging Face APIs (metadata and file listings only), HTTP HEAD for sizes, papers (Europe PMC full text, arXiv/ar5iv), licence pages. No image or model file was downloaded.

evidence_levels.verified_primary: read on the dataset's own record/paper/licence page or API in this run
evidence_levels.verified_secondary: read in a secondary source (other paper, code, search result) in this run
evidence_levels.unverified: could not be checked (page blocked or not documented)

datasets.name: StreetSurfaceVis V1.0
datasets.publisher: HTW Berlin, SurfaceAI project (Kapp, Hoffmann, Weigmann, Mihaljević)

paper.citation: Kapp A. et al., Sci Data 12, 92 (2025)

licence.notes: Zenodo licence field cc-by-sa-4.0. Paper: dataset provided under CC-BY-SA in accordance with Mapillary's CC-BY-SA licensing of user images; attribution to each image's creator required (mapillary_image_id + user_name in CSV). Mapillary terms forbid reversing face/plate blurring. Mapillary help page itself returned HTTP 403 (licence of Mapillary images therefore verified_secondary via the paper).

licence_compatibility.mit_app_code: Compatible if images/weights are never placed in the MIT repository; keep data outside the repo.
licence_compatibility.model_weights: Uncertain: CC FAQ says whether a model/output is an Adaptation depends on applicable law; conservative policy = any distributed weights carry CC BY-SA 4.0 + attribution, separate from MIT code.
licence_compatibility.commercial_use: Allowed by CC BY-SA 4.0 (with attribution and share-alike).
licence_compatibility.odbl_osm: Do not contribute model-derived surface tags to OSM; CC BY-SA material is not ODbL-compatible without a waiver. Mixing CC BY-SA-derived predictions with ODbL data in one public database needs legal review before any integration.

label_provenance.details: Every image manually labelled by one of three annotators (the first three authors) following a written labelling guide; candidates pre-selected with OSM tags, iterative CNN pseudo-labels, GPT-4o prompts and embedding similarity search (pre-selection only). Inter-rater check: 180 images (10 per OSM pre-label class) rated by all three; 12 marked for revision and 49 discarded were excluded; Krippendorff alpha 0.96 (type), 0.74 (quality). OSM pre-labels agreed with manual type labels on only 69% of a 1,800-image batch.
discrepancies: Zenodo description says 1,800 images were annotated by all three annotators; the paper says 180 (the 1,800 figure matches the OSM pre-label batch of 100 x 18 classes).
Zenodo table lists asphalt-good 1,697 (sum 9,123); paper Table 5 lists 1,696 (sum 9,122 = stated total).

official_test_split.description: urban areas of five German cities excluded from training (flag train=False); cities not named

external_transfer_hint.text: SurfaceAI pipeline paper reports type accuracy 0.76 and paving-stones F1 0.58 in a rural German municipality (urban-trained model)

geography.notes: Images within Germany's bounding box ('mostly from Germany').

viewpoint.type: crowdsourced street-level (Mapillary; smartphone app and other devices; car, bicycle, on foot); label = focal road at bottom centre

datasets.sampling_notes: Max 5 images per zoom-14 tile (~1.5 km) and 10 per Mapillary sequence; class-targeted pre-selection, so class prevalence is NOT real-world prevalence.

smallest_usable_variant.reason: The authors' own production pipeline downloads 1024-px Mapillary thumbnails, crops the lower-middle half and resizes to 384 px. In s_256 the focal crop is only ~128x96 px, below this pipeline's 256x192 working size; sett joints would be largely lost. s_256.zip remains a cheaper fallback (--variant 256).

datasets.verdict: RECOMMENDED (only trustworthy candidate found): human labels, explicit sett class, per-image coordinates, geographic test split, share-alike but commercially usable licence. Germany-only: cannot measure Italian performance.

datasets.name: Cycling Street Surface Dataset
datasets.publisher: Scharf (re:edu GmbH & Co. KG), Karic (University of Münster)

label_provenance.type: annotated by the authors (no protocol, no agreement statistics published)

geography.value: not documented (authors in Münster, Germany - inferred)

viewpoint.type: close-range bicycle-mounted OV2640 camera; crops 96x96 and 48x192 px

datasets.verdict: OPTIONAL LATER cross-viewpoint check only; undocumented counts, location and label protocol; tiny low-resolution crops. Not proposed for phase 2.

datasets.name: RTK - Road Traversing Knowledge

licence.notes: Project page asks for citation only; no licence = all rights reserved by default.

label_provenance.type: human ground truth by the authors; agreement not reported

classes.notes: 'paved' lumps all non-asphalt pavements; no separate sett class

geography.value: Aguas Mornas and Santo Amaro da Imperatriz, Santa Catarina, Brazil

viewpoint.type: low-cost HP webcam in a moving vehicle; consecutive video frames (near-duplicates)

datasets.files: many zip parts under http://www.lapix.ufsc.br/wp-content/uploads/2019/03/ and 2019/10/; sizes not shown
datasets.verdict: REJECT: no reuse licence, no sett class, single route of video frames, no coordinates. StreetSurfaceVis paper reports RTK-trained models generalise poorly.

licence.id: CC BY-NC (author site, per search result)
licence.notes: GitHub repo code is MIT; dataset page shows no licence text.

datasets.name: RoadSaW - Road Surface and Wetness

viewpoint.type: bird's-eye-view projected road patches from calibrated vehicle cameras (7.5-30 m ahead)

datasets.verdict: REJECT for Lastrico: NonCommercial + ShareAlike, projected patches unlike a phone view, no coordinates for geographic splits. At most a research-only benchmark if the owner confirms purely non-commercial use.

licence.id: research licence reported as CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by secondary sources; ICCV 2017 paper mentions CC-BY-SA

datasets.name: Mapillary images + OSM surface tags (weak labels)

label_provenance.quality: OSM pre-labels agreed with manual surface-type labels on 69% of images in the StreetSurfaceVis study

datasets.access: Mapillary API needs a (free) client token tied to an account - an owner action; this agent may not create accounts.
datasets.local_hint: data/surfaces/milan-central.json contains 33 OSM objects with mapillary=* (8 unique image ids), all surface=asphalt: no pave examples.
datasets.verdict: REJECT for training (label noise ~31%, circular with Lastrico's own OSM knowledge, ODbL/CC BY-SA mixing). Useful later only as a source of Milan images for a HUMAN-labelled Italian evaluation set.

datasets.name: Road Damage Dataset: Potholes, Cracks, and Manholes (Rome)
datasets.verdict: REJECT for surface type (damage boxes only). Only Italian street imagery found; not usable for pave.

datasets.name: IRD-Dataset (Baghdad)
datasets.verdict: REJECT: road defects, no surface-material classes, 20.9 GB.

datasets.name: Aerial road-surface patches (Frontiers in Big Data 2025)
datasets.verdict: REJECT: US aerial imagery, no sett class.

datasets.name: Large-scale Road Surface Classification Dataset from Sentinel-2 and OpenStreetMap
datasets.verdict: REJECT: satellite resolution, OSM weak labels.
